title: Red Hat Security Advisory: nodejs22 security update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities affecting Node.js and its dependencies have been addressed in a Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10.0 Extended Update Support release. These include denial of service issues in brace-expansion and undici libraries, certificate validation bypasses, TLS certificate hostname bypass, and DNS resolution flaws. The update mitigates risks related to uncontrolled recursion, stack exhaustion, unhandled stream errors, TLS renegotiation mismatches, and improper hostname handling.
